title: CapabilityGrant
description: Minted by the control plane per node attempt (ADR-0005 §4). Derived from the graph node definition intersected with the repository registry's capability ceiling, never from anything the model produced. Monotonically non-increasing: no operation grows a grant mid-attempt, and a retry receives a fresh grant so a failed attempt leaves no residual authority. The agent runtime never handles a grant, only the attempt token that resolves to it.

schemaVersion.description: ADR-0024 §5: stored documents are versioned as data. One version exists in V1.

subject.description: The NodeRun attempt this grant authorises, using the four-part key of ADR-0021 §1. iteration is required: without it, two attempts in different loop rounds would share a subject.

allowedTools.description: Explicit tool ids and versions. ADR-0005 §4: never a wildcard. An empty list is valid and means no tool may be invoked.

pathScope.description: ADR-0023 §3. The key set must equal repositoryScope exactly — a grant cannot constrain paths in a repository it does not scope, nor scope a repository whose paths it leaves unconstrained. That equality is a cross-field rule JSON Schema cannot express; it is checked when the grant is minted, and INV-89 records where.

commandProfiles.description: Named profiles this attempt may run (ADR-0005 §5). Adding a profile is a reviewed human change to repository configuration; nothing here lets an agent introduce one.

maxDenials.description: Denial circuit breaker (ADR-0005 §6). Exceeding it fails the node with TOOL_DENIED, which surfaces a wrong grant instead of letting a model spend its whole budget rediscovering that it may not do something.

notAfter.description: Attempt deadline. The grant is invalid after this instant even if budget remains.
